source: The graded episode of the online variant: drawn 2026-11-18T04:41:49Z with secrets.randbelow(3) (OS entropy) over the seeds of episodes.json (the offline verifier's fixed hidden set, in its order), index 1. seed_sha256 is sha256 of the seed's decimal digits; the seed itself is root-only in environment/setup/online/episode.json, which the service reads as root before it drops privileges.
